reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the correct output for a compliance finding (retained as internal evidence, not a negotiation issue).

The cited text supports compliance: § 3.1 is a pure revenue share (30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly floor), so the Company pays only on actual sales achieved and owes nothing absent revenue — this matches the MINCOMMIT preferred position (fees for usage/ordered services only). The $11,000 figure operates as a fee-free threshold in our favour, not a minimum spend.

No take-or-pay, shortfall, committed volume or usage cap on the Company appears in the supplied paragraphs, and § 4.1 provides a one-year term with a standing 90-day termination right, so there is no walk-away exposure under this rule.

Adjacent terms are correctly triaged rather than double-flagged: the § 4.2 Termination Payment is an exit fee keyed to actual Net Sales (and floors at zero), properly routed to the termination-fee rule, and § 6.1 exclusivity is a channel restriction for the exclusivity rule — consistent with the instruction not to flag the same commercial term twice.
No deterministic check failures; nothing in the record contradicts the rationale.
